tooltip.brief_guard.underwear_slot: Equip slot: dedicated underwear slot (does not take the chestplate slot)
tooltip.brief_guard.attack: Attack damage when held: +%s (sweet berry bush damage type)
tooltip.brief_guard.m_dragon_head: Charge in fire/lava; full charge beeps then your next hit blasts; fire immune
tooltip.brief_guard.m_chastity: Gain a guard layer every 12s unharmed; fully block when a layer is ready
tooltip.brief_guard.m_slime: Crouch still to charge (~1s, sfx+sparks when full), release to spring; no fall damage
tooltip.brief_guard.m_spicy: Heat builds up; periodic beep when full, empty-hand right-click to breathe fire
tooltip.brief_guard.m_poop: Swamp aura poisons nearby foes; splashes on landing
tooltip.brief_guard.m_silverfish: Chance to summon guards when you are hit
tooltip.brief_guard.m_tentacle: Water breathing; pull and slow foes with underwater attacks
tooltip.brief_guard.m_edible: Auto-eats when hungry; empty-hand right-click to heal
tooltip.brief_guard.m_trapdoor: Crouch still to hide; sneak attacks blind your target
tooltip.brief_guard.m_promotion: Kills build rank; full rank triggers a buff burst
tooltip.brief_guard.m_sticky_piston: Powerful knockback, item magnet; deflects attackers when hit
tooltip.brief_guard.m_gaseous: Floats gently in air (feet puff clouds), crouch to dive; blows attackers away when hit
tooltip.brief_guard.m_sword: Huge attack damage; chance to sweep nearby foes
tooltip.brief_guard.m_shield: Crouch-block to reduce damage with a parry chance; sneak attack becomes a bash
